title: Hotel Paseo, Autograph Collection
description: Palm Desert's first new luxury boutique hotel in over 30 years — 150 rooms, steps from El Paseo, preferred golf partner of Desert Willow, meeting capacity for up to 300 guests. Marriott Autograph Collection flag.
agent_summary: Hotel Paseo is a 150-room Marriott Autograph Collection boutique hotel in Palm Desert, the first new luxury property built in the city in over 30 years, adjacent to El Paseo shopping and a preferred partner of Desert Willow Golf Resort.
